mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log ( operator_user_id, operator_name, role_code, module_name, operation_type, operation_desc, request_url, result_status, error_message, ip_address, execution_time, create_time ) VALUES ( #{operatorUserId}, #{operatorName}, #{roleCode}, #{moduleName}, #{operationType}, #{operationDesc}, #{requestUrl}, #{resultStatus}, #{errorMessage}, #{ipAddress}, #{executionTime}, NOW() )

sql.if: AND (operator_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR operation_desc LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT id, operator_name AS operatorName, role_code AS roleCode, module_name AS moduleName, operation_type AS operationType, operation_desc AS operationDesc, request_url AS requestUrl, result_status AS resultStatus, error_message AS errorMessage, ip_address AS ipAddress, execution_time AS executionTime, create_time AS createTime FROM operation_log WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}
